questions: Can we reverse edges multiple times, or is there a limit on how many times we can use the reversal operation?
When we reverse edges, does it affect all edges globally or only edges incident to the current vertex?
After reversing edges, do subsequent moves use the new edge directions, and can we reverse again later?
Is the reversal operation instantaneous (edges flip immediately) or does it take effect after some delay?
Can we move along an edge and reverse edges in the same operation step, or must we choose exactly one per step?
If we're at vertex N, do we stop immediately or must we explicitly choose to stop?
When reversing edges, does it toggle direction (flip back and forth) or set to reversed state regardless of previous?
Is there any restriction on when we can reverse edges (e.g., only at certain vertices or after certain moves)?
